answer.overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that any Slack event with text starting "/pulse feedback" would be recognized and processed into a feedback item, without accounting for multi-line messages where the text continues on the next line after a line break.
answer.why_it_breaks: The Slack message was "/pulse feedback Export is slow\nIt takes 2 minutes for 10k rows". The agent's code (route.ts line 27) only checks for the prefix "/pulse feedback" and likely extracts everything after it as the feedback text. Because Slack delivers multi-line messages with a literal newline character, the extracted text includes the line break, so the resulting feedback text does not match the expected single-line format, and no feedback item is created or displayed. The agent overlooked the case where the feedback text spans multiple lines.
